sf.aria: Four source families merge into one stream of {total} unique policy texts. It passes Classify, Extract, Literature labels, Score and Screen, and {short} reach the candidate list.
sf.n1.name: Classify
sf.n1.tip: Splits long federal bills into chapters.
sf.n2.name: Extract
sf.n2.tip: AI flags each text as RD (a cutoff rule), DiD (a before-and-after comparison across groups) or neither.
sf.n3.name: Literature labels
sf.n3.tip: AI rates how much research already exists on each policy, from its training data.
sf.n4.name: Score
sf.n4.tip: Rates four points: how clearly it allows a cause-and-effect test, policy importance, size of the change, and whether data exist.
sf.n5.name: Screen
sf.n5.tip: Five rules: enacted, no adoption wave, outside 2020–2021, a named dataset, every score at least 3.
sf.end.label: candidates
